theme: Dark Mode Default (Statx AI Tech Aesthetic)

rules.headings: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings above 32px. Use font-light or font-black to create tension.
rules.body: Use leading-relaxed for chat messages and long text.
rules.hierarchy: H1: text-4xl to text-5xl max. H2: text-2xl to text-3xl. Gap between H1 and subtitle should not exceed 2 steps.

colors.rules: Never use pure transparent backgrounds if content scrolls under. Avoid #808080. Tint grays slightly blue. Only use primary color for CTAs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'GRID BORDERS' for Dashboard panels (border-collapse, border-r, border-b). Use 'Crystal Glass' for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 + 1px bottom border).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Ground elements with sharp 1px borders (border-white/10).

components.general: Prioritize Shadcn components. Avoid pure HTML interactive elements (no <select>).
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow, border brightens.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Explicit text colors on hover.
components.chat_interface: User bubble: bg-primary text-white. AI bubble: bg-surface border border-white/10. Include markdown support.
components.controls: Use ToggleGroup or Tabs for Auto/Web/AI-only controls. Segmented, clearly labeled.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (MODE B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. h-full on children.
layouts.chat_workspace: Bento style. Center chat column (max-w-3xl) + side panels for Provider Settings, Citations, Web Search results.
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. 2-3x more spacing than default.
layouts.provider_dashboard: Use status cards for OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq/Gemini with health/cooldown visual indicators (green/yellow/red dots).

motion.rules: Minimalist micro-interactions. Hover states on all interactive elements. MUST respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.rules: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. data-testid attributes are MANDATORY on all interactive and key informational elements.

auth_background.description: a blue background with lines and dots

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write standard Javascript (.js / .jsx) instead of Typescript (.tsx). The project uses Vite + JS.
Build the unified Statx experience in the provided workspace. Preserve all existing functionality from the problem statement.
Required pages/views: Login, Dashboard, AI Workspace, Provider Dashboard, Conversations, Documents, Competency, Results, Assessment, Settings.
Integrate Shadcn components into the JS setup. Do not use standard HTML forms/inputs for advanced interactions.
Implement real web search provider UI integration (configurable provider with normalized sources/citations).
Design UI for Auto/Web/AI-only controls using segmented controls (e.g., Shadcn Tabs or ToggleGroup).
Design a Provider Dashboard that visually tracks cooldown/health for OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, and Gemini.
Ensure the UI reflects a premium, high-end 'Statx AI' brand identity following the Swiss High-Contrast Dark Theme.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react is standard for Shadcn) for a clean, technical look.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Never use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Ensure 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create crisp, layered, professional UIs without generic uniform styling.
